correctness.rationale: The digitwise mod-five constant-term factorization has a unique balanced base-five exponent decomposition; T_0,...,T_4 are units. Pan--Sun Theorem 1.1 gives v5(T_{5n}-T_n)>=2+2v5(n) for all n>0. Repeated Frobenius lifting and disjoint Laurent supports give separated block product congruences at every fixed precision. U_2 is 3 modulo 25, a generator modulo all 5^k; arbitrarily separated blocks realize every power with unbounded indices. The packaged exact checker corroborates bounded instances; no computation is promoted to an infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Sun treats congruences for these coefficients; Pan--Sun proves a dilation estimate. Neither inspected theorem asserts an all-depth full image at p=5. The dyadic full image has different modulus and does not dominate the five-adic claim.

value.rationale: Determines the entire inverse-limit set of values of a classical combinatorial sequence, not just finite congruences or a fixed-prime mod-p digit test. The primitive-unit limit plus arbitrary separation lifts every one of the 5^k-5^(k-1) unit targets, infinitely many times, at every depth, with no zeros. The exact image is motivated by p-adic residue classification and is strictly stronger than ordinary Lucas congruences.
